preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 20.
The length of strings A and B must be between 1 and 1000.
Strings A and B must have the same length N.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A + B)
preconditions.description: Strings A and B must contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible else str(K) + '\n' + '\n'.join(operations)
postconditions.description: If conversion is impossible, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum number of operations K followed by the operations.
The number of operations K must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(len(S) > 0 and all(x in range(N) for x in S) for S in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must specify a non-empty subset S of indices within the range of N.
